---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, integration, or workflow improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What's the problem?
What are you trying to do today that's harder than it should be? Describe the friction in 1-2 sentences.

## Proposed solution
What would you like CodeNow to do? Be as specific as you can — UI sketches, command syntax, example file/folder structure all help.

## Alternatives considered
Is there a workaround you're using today? Other tools that solve this well?

## Additional context
- Which CodeNow surface? (IDE / Agent Studio / Migration / Channels / Share / Wiki)
- Frequency: how often would you use this?
- Anything we should *not* do (cases where this feature should NOT trigger)
